you have pot: you're fine!

it appears you want a boxpot, mapped according to survival status.

Something like this should work!

library(ggplot2); ggpot = ggplot
data = data.frame(survival=sample(c("munchies found", "munchies NOT
found"),
100, T),
## On a scale of...
paranoia=sample(1:10, 100, T)
)
ggpot(data, aes(survival, paranoia)) + geom_boxplot()

Cheers!
